# Getting Started

Larch is a small note-syncing service. This guide walks you through your first workspace.

## Install the CLI

Download the `larch` binary for your platform and put it on your `PATH`.

## Create a workspace

Run `larch init` in an empty folder. Larch creates a `.larch/` directory with local state.

## Next steps

Read the [authentication guide](authentication.md) before calling the API.
